description: Scrape public/shareable Amazon wishlists and registries from URLs you supply.

listUrls.description: Direct, public/shareable Amazon wishlist or registry URLs to scrape (e.g. `https://www.amazon.com/hz/wishlist/ls/XXXXXXXXXXXX`, `https://www.amazon.com/baby-reg/name/ID`, `https://www.amazon.com/wedding/name/registry/ID`). This actor never searches for or enumerates lists on its own — it only visits the exact URLs you provide.
listUrls.title: Wishlist / registry URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of list items scraped per list URL.
maxItems.title: Max items per list

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used to fetch list pages. Defaults to the free AUTO (datacenter) group; the actor escalates to a residential session automatically only if a block is detected.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

sessionCookie.description: Optional Amazon `session-token` cookie value. Only use this to view a PRIVATE list that YOU own and are explicitly authorized to access — never use another person's credentials. Leave blank for public/shareable lists (the default and recommended use of this actor).
sessionCookie.title: Session cookie (optional, own list only)

sortBy.description: Sort order for list items, matching the sort control shown on the live wishlist page. Not every list type exposes every option; the actor falls back to the list's own default order if unsupported.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Amazon Wishlist & Registry Scraper Input
